summary: Frontend regression for MEDILO Customer Profile Phase 3 (Notifications, About MEDILO, Privacy & Security). Logged in as customer 9876543210, verified Profile menu wiring, navigation to all 3 new routes, dialogs and delete-account API call. 33/34 assertions passed; the single failure is a test-script timing issue (post-delete toast covering back button), not a product bug.

design_issues.screen: Privacy & Security dialogs (Privacy Policy, Terms, Delete Account)
issues: Radix Dialog console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for accessibility compliance.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority a11y) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to Dialogs in PrivacySecurity.js and Profile edit dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Profile.js menuItems use `item.label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')` for data-testid which generates `menu-privacy-&-security` (ampersand in selector). Works but is fragile; consider explicit testid keys per item (e.g. `menu-privacy`, `menu-about`).
Notifications.js: handleMarkRead silently swallows errors (empty catch). Consider toasting failure or logging.

PrivacySecurity.js: After successful delete-account-request, user is not redirected/logged out; only a toast appears. Verify if expected UX is to auto-logout or at minimum disable the button to prevent duplicate submissions.
All three new pages hardcode navigate('/profile') on back button instead of navigate(-1); may break if entered via deep link.
test_credentials: Customer phone 9876543210 (no OTP required in pilot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer 9876543210 has 24 prior orders, 1 address, 2 wishlist items, and now 1 pending account-deletion request (POST /api/customer/delete-account-request was triggered and returned 200 during this run). Notifications list was empty. All three new routes (/profile/notifications, /profile/about, /profile/privacy) are wired correctly. Profile menu testids: menu-notifications, menu-about-medilo, menu-privacy-&-security. Existing menu regression (orders/addresses/wishlist/prescriptions/support) all PASS.
rca of the issue: The single failed assertion 'Back from Privacy' was caused by Sonner success toast intercepting the back-button click after delete-account submission — not a product bug. Manual nav via direct URL /profile worked. No fix required.
